body.p: Arms Race has returned! Grab your guns and brace yourself for a chaotic race to the top. Get two kills with each weapon to reach the final stage, or steal your opponents’ progress with your knife (or now with the Zeus)! Work your way up to the knife stage and earn the final kill to secure the win.
There's a lot more shipping today, from custom sticker placement to new content to gameplay updates. Click here to learn more!
